title: Photo Booth Hire Essex | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Essex photo booth hire for weddings, birthdays and corporate parties from Chelmsford to Southend. Packages from £299 with attendant. Call 07368 631 516.
intro: Essex loves a party, and Boothdrop Entertainment supplies photo booth hire for every kind of celebration across the county, from Epping Forest to the Southend seafront and up to Colchester and Saffron Walden. Packages start at £299 and include an attendant, free delivery and setup, unlimited sessions and a print design created for your event.

sections.heading: Showpiece booths for showpiece parties
paragraphs: Essex events tend to go big, and the Inflatable Booth is our most asked-for option in the county. The LED glow is set to match the colour scheme, up to ten guests can pile in together and prints are produced for everyone in the shot. For glamorous weddings in country clubs and barns, the Magic Mirror offers a full-length interactive frame with animations and games that look the part against a styled backdrop.

The 360 Booth has taken off for birthdays, engagement parties and Asian weddings around Chelmsford, Brentwood and Basildon, delivering slow-motion video clips with music for instant sharing; we confirm its space and power needs for your venue at quote stage. The Selfie Mirror Pod is the compact alternative where a smaller room still wants mirror-style photos and instant prints.
list: Inflatable Booth: colour-matched glow, up to ten people per photo
Magic Mirror: full-length frame, animations and prints for everyone
360 Booth: slow-motion video built for social sharing
Selfie Mirror Pod: mirror photos in a two-metre footprint

sections.heading: Planning advice for Essex weddings and celebrations
paragraphs: Weddings in Essex barns and country clubs are often styled to the last detail, so we design the print template to match the stationery and ask for the colour palette when you book. The booth usually opens after the wedding breakfast and runs through the evening, with the attendant keeping the guest book filled with prints and messages. Asian weddings around Brentwood, Harlow and the Romford edge are large, multi-day affairs, and we are happy to supply the booth for the reception, the mehndi or both.

Birthday parties, especially milestone ones, are a major part of our Essex work, alongside corporate Christmas parties for businesses in Chelmsford, Basildon and Colchester and school proms in June and July. For proms we keep sessions quick and props plentiful; for Christmas parties a branded overlay and a digital gallery sent to the organiser afterwards are the usual requests.

sections.heading: Across the county, from the M25 to the coast
paragraphs: Chelmsford, the county's only city, is busy enough to have its own page with local venue notes. We also cover Colchester, Braintree, Witham and Maldon to the north and east, Southend-on-Sea, Leigh-on-Sea, Rayleigh and Basildon along the estuary, and Brentwood, Billericay, Epping, Loughton and Harlow on the London side. Saffron Walden, up near the Cambridgeshire border, rounds out the north-west.

The A12 is the main artery through Chelmsford towards Colchester, the A127 and A13 take us down to Southend and the estuary towns, and the A130 links Chelmsford with Basildon and Rayleigh. The M25 and M11 give access to Epping, Loughton, Harlow and the north-west of the county. Delivery and setup are included wherever the venue is.

sections.heading: Barns, seafront venues and country clubs
paragraphs: Essex has an unusually high number of converted barns, many of them timber-framed with oak beams and vaulted ceilings, and they are the backbone of the county's wedding scene. Country clubs and golf clubs with large function suites are another strong category, along with hotels in Chelmsford, Colchester and Brentwood that cater for weddings, awards nights and Christmas parties.

On the coast, Southend and Leigh-on-Sea offer seafront hotels, pier-side rooms and beach venues for summer parties. Epping Forest has woodland hotels and country houses on the London fringe. Village halls, cricket and sports clubs and community centres host the more relaxed birthdays and christenings.

sections.heading: Getting in and getting set up
paragraphs: Barn venues are frequently at the end of farm tracks with gravel or loose-stone yards, so we arrive in good time and use trolleys to bring the equipment to the door. Old barn floors can be uneven; we just need a level patch large enough for the booth, up to four metres square for the Inflatable Booth. Seafront venues in Southend may have restricted parking, and we confirm the unloading spot in advance.

Setup takes around 45 to 60 minutes before the hire window starts and is not billed as hire time. One standard socket runs most booths; the Inflatable Booth needs two. Marquee receptions in barn courtyards or gardens need a reliable 13A supply, so please check with the marquee company that any generator is sized for the booth as well as lighting and catering, and that the socket is within a few metres of the booth position.

faqs.q: Where will you park at a Southend seafront venue?
faqs.a: We agree an unloading point with the venue beforehand, usually a loading bay or a short-stay space near the entrance, bring the equipment inside and then move the vehicle to a nearby car park. If the seafront has restrictions on the day, tell us and we will plan around them.

faqs.q: Can the booth be set up in a marquee next to a barn?
faqs.a: Yes. We need a firm, level floor, cover from the weather and a reliable 13A socket within a few metres of the booth. If the marquee is powered by a generator, please ask the supplier to confirm it can carry the booth, lighting and catering together without the supply dipping.

faqs.q: Is there a travel charge for Colchester or Saffron Walden?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included in every package, and both towns are comfortably within our regular Essex coverage. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue it is shown on the quote up front, so there is nothing added later.

faqs.q: Can the Inflatable Booth glow match our wedding colours?
faqs.a: Yes, the LED lighting inside the enclosure can be set to a colour that matches your theme, whether that is blush pink, deep navy or a changing cycle. Tell us the palette when you book and the attendant sets it up on the day.

faqs.q: Do you cover Asian weddings in Essex?
faqs.a: We do, from the mehndi to the reception. Print templates can include names in English and a second language, colours are matched to the decor, and the attendant is experienced with large guest lists. The 360 Booth and Magic Mirror are the most popular choices for these events.
